Public role-intake check. Use the files in this directory. Do not bind source and artifact to the same path.

Work call, one task, option work. Put nothing else beside tasks except review_contract:

review_contract.workflow = role_intake
review_contract.source.path = the absolute path of source.md
review_contract.artifact.path = a new absolute path ending in harbor-draft.md
review_contract.requirements.path = the absolute path of requirements.txt

The worker must create harbor-draft.md. Its bytes must differ from source.md.
Do not put output_schema beside tasks. The host installs the work schema.

After that file exists, one review call, option review, with the same review_contract.
A needs_revision result is not acceptance. role_intake_bound must be true.
Do not release. Do not write an owner approval.
